name: To Boil Rice
description: Historical recipe from The Virginia Housewife; Or, Methodical Cook (1824). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: two and a half cups of cold water
ingredients.originalText: two and a half cups of cold water

instructions.text: Put two cups full of rice in a bowl of water, rub it well with the hand, and pour off the water
Do this until the water ceases to be discoloured
Put the rice into two and a half cups of cold water
Add a tea-spoonful of salt, cover the pot close, and set it on a brisk fire
Let it boil ten minutes, pour off the greater part of the water, and remove the pot to a bed of coals, where it must remain a quarter of an hour to soak and dry

source.author: Mary Randolph
source.originalInstructions:
1. Put two cups full of rice in a bowl of water, rub it well with the hand, and pour off the water
2. Do this until the water ceases to be discoloured
3. Put the rice into two and a half cups of cold water
4. Add a tea-spoonful of salt, cover the pot close, and set it on a brisk fire
5. Let it boil ten minutes, pour off the greater part of the water, and remove the pot to a bed of coals, where it must remain a quarter of an hour to soak and dry
